seed.projection: All HEAD-reachable commits; sorted git ls-tree -r COMMIT -- game records excluding game/tests/; omit empty states; globally collapse identical projected trees. No lazy fetching or blob reads.
seed.scope: Committed production-source states, including branch development. Not an exact lifetime/uncommitted iteration count, exported-build count, PR number, test count or monitor-attempt count.

policy: Advance once for a new admitted production-source candidate. Aliases and source-identical packaging, signing, notarization or monitoring retries reuse that candidate's reserved ordinal. Issued failed ordinals remain recorded and are never reused. Do not advance for documentation/test-only changes. Minimum three decimal digits; no Alpha, Major Features or Preview suffix for new public identities. Final source commit and exact artifacts are bound in the external release ledger after commit, avoiding a self-referential source hash.
